name: ChatGPT Next Web
description: An intelligent chat application based on ChatGPT, supports fast deployment, Markdown, beautiful UI, fluid response, privacy and security, and allows customization of preset roles for quick creation, sharing, and debugging of personalized conversations.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  chatgpt-next-web:
    environment:
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
      CODE: ""
      PROXY_URL: ""
      BASE_URL: "https://api.openai.com"
    image: yidadaa/chatgpt-next-web:v2.16.1
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    container_name: chatgpt-next-web
